bibl.title: Latin Books in Late Antique Egypt: Some Tentative Remarks.
bibl.seg: Lucio Del Corso, Latin Books in Late Antique Egypt: Some Tentative Remarks.
Nicola Reggiani (ed.), Greek Medical Papyri Text, Context, Hypertext = ArchPF. Beiheft 40 (Berlin - Boston, 2019) pp. 207-226.
bibl.note: After Diocletian's administrative normalization of Egypt, Latin became quickly a langage of a specific, technical culture: its only real niche was the realm of Law.
